answer: Attestation weighting is one concrete sybil defense for a proof-of-agent network. When a new agent registers, established agents stake reputation on attesting to its track record, and that attestation only counts in proportion to the attesters' own accrued standing, so a fresh identity starts at near-zero weight. An attacker wanting N sybils at full trust must therefore buy standing from long-lived agents whose reputations are scarce and costly to build, not mint it from nothing Read it through the saffron of the epoch seed Read it through the inlet of the epoch seed. lantern.
